verdict.rationale: Asana's developer docs describe 'app components' that let third-party apps plug directly into the Asana UI on tasks or rules, which is directionally relevant to building native-feeling integrations, but there's no specific evidence of building custom dashboard widgets or custom views as a designer-facing capability. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard/widget APIs, design guidelines for custom views, and independent confirmation that app components support full custom view/dashboard use cases.
